steps.content: Perhaps since they regained confidence, this battle goes more smoothly than the previous ones.
After putting her bow and arrows away, EMP sees Josh standing motionless with his head down in the corner.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Hey, why are you still standing there? Let's go! The monsters are all defeated...

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Ah!!
EMP reaches out to pull him, but the cold and strange feeling makes her yelp and retract her hand.
Josh stumbles straight to the ground, making a crisp crashing sound.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: What the hell is this?!! I-I-I didn't do anything...
Hella gulps and gathers enough courage to check. She pokes Josh's arm.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: It's stone... He... He turned into a statue.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: A statue?!
EMP turns Josh over... he has turned into a cold gray statue. Only the wide-open eyes tell the fear he experienced minutes ago.
As the duo gape at each other, the navigator, who has been silent for a long time, opens her mouth again.

steps.speaker: Dahlia Guide
steps.content: I see. I think I have worked out the truth of Witching Hour.

steps.speaker: Dahlia Guide
steps.content: Based on the Corrupted Sinners just now, and Josh, who has been turned into a statue, I suspect that Witching Hour has the power to visualize the visitors' fear and turn them into part of the exhibition when they're extremely frightened.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: So the reason EMP felt something wrong...

steps.speaker: Dahlia Guide
steps.content: Ah, she felt something wrong, not because of someone else's fear, but because the next room houses the Gate of Hell.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: The Gate of Hell?

steps.speaker: Dahlia Guide
steps.content: Yes, the Gate of Hell. It was the work I was most proud of, before Sosia was born.

steps.speaker: Dahlia Guide
steps.content: The little girl you defeated earlier didn't turn into a broken statue like the other monsters, probably because it was created by the awakening of the Gate of Hell.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: The thing can be awakened? That doesn't sound good...

steps.speaker: Dahlia Guide
steps.content: Correct, and I think it has something to do with the Chief you are looking for.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ****! So he's right ahead?! Finally!
The navigator doesn't deny it but continues to speak calmly after a short pause.

steps.speaker: Dahlia Guide
steps.content: The road ahead will only get more dangerous. Are you sure you want to keep going?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Of course! We can't let that idiot ${PlayerName} get bullied!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Ahhhh I can't stand this place anymore!!! I wanna latch onto the Chief right now!!!
